Sam: midday standup — quick notes:
- Done: merged routing spec PR (#487) + added canary config
- Blockers: quant tests failing on fp16 after latest kernel change; seeing OOM in 8k sequences on deduped test set
- Today: triage kernel issue with @Maya, prep canary rollout, ping CR reviewers

Maya: I can take profiling on the fp16 runs. Can you drop the failing logs here? :eyes:

Sam: dropping logs:
```
E runtime: OOM when allocating 12 GB buffer at step 42
Model: gpt-neox-20b, seq_len=8192, batch=1
Kernel: fused_attn_v2
```

Leo: I can pick up the CR review for #487 after lunch. FYI QA flagged a mismatch in the sample responses vs spec (structured output). I'll file a tiny follow-up issue and attach examples.

Jun: Heads-up: legal approved data send for Canary only if we strip user_ids; I'll handle the sanitize script today and share a small hygiene wrapper.

Maya: copied — starting profiling now. If OOM repros, will try smaller micro-batch & kv-cache tweak (will test micro_batch=1, seq_shard=2).

Sam: thanks — @Leo please add your QA notes to the PR. @Jun once sanitized dataset is ready, I'll schedule canary for 3pm PT. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary build queued: canary/2026-03-17-15:00 (owner: Sam)

Leo: ack, will update PR with QA notes in ~90m.

Sam: perfect. If anyone hits something blocking the canary, ping this thread. Otherwise short sync at 2:45 for go/no-go.
